name: Bootloadable_Metadata

name: Bootloadable_ApplicationChecksum

name: Bootloadable_ApplicationEntryPoint

name: Bootloadable_BootloaderLastRow

name: Bootloadable_ApplicationLength

name: Bootloadable_ApplicationRunType

name: Bootloadable_ApplicationActive

name: Bootloadable_ApplicationVerified
evidence: Verified byte 0 at CYACD ASCII offset 0x33196. Excluded from application checksum.

name: Bootloadable_BootloaderVersion

name: Bootloadable_ApplicationId

name: Bootloadable_ApplicationVersion

name: Bootloadable_ApplicationCustomerId
